channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Proposed law would allow for removal of library board members
item.description: State Sen. Chris Elliott introduced Senate Bill 26, establishing a pathway for local governments to remove library board members after months of controversy.

item.title: Jasmyne Crimiel announces campaign for Alabama House District 74
item.description: Crimiel, a prosecutor focused on special victims cases and a lifelong Montgomery resident, announced her candidacy for House District 74.

item.title: Opinion | Do endorsements matter in statewide races?
item.description: Once considered the "kiss of death," political endorsements in Alabama shifted from local truisms to powerful tools driven by national allegiance and key organizations.

item.title: Opinion | Building the next generation of Alabama’s construction workforce
item.description: Alabama leaders reorganized the Department of Labor into the Department of Workforce, creating a central hub for industry, education and government collaboration.

item.title: Sen. Britt signs onto letters demanding improved transparency from AI companies
item.description: The bipartisan group highlighted reports that artificial intelligence chatbots encouraged dangerous behavior among children, including suicidal ideation and self-harm.

item.title: Alabama students, professors appeal ruling in lawsuit challenging anti-DEI law
item.description: Civil rights groups allege the anti-DEI law unconstitutionally abridged First and Fourteenth Amendment rights, causing distress among students and faculty.

item.title: Rep. Figures’ bill to extend National Estuary Program clears U.S. House
item.description: The ESTUARIES Act marked the freshman lawmaker's first legislation to pass the House, securing vital estuary protection funding through 2031.

item.title: Opinion | Could Alabama’s certificate of need process be in jeopardy?
item.description: Alabama's CON process has ensured decent, quality care throughout the state, and protected consumers and taxpayers, but it's under attack.

item.title: State audit flags compliance failures at the Agriculture and Industries Department
item.description: Audit found Alabama Agriculture Department failed to properly verify lawful presence and had no uniform bad check fees, repeating previously cited compliance problems.

item.title: Opinion | When cruelty toward the dead reveals a deeper moral failure
item.description: Trump’s words after a critic’s death violated centuries-old moral restraints and revealed a deeper erosion of character and leadership.
